from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one provided paper, capturing its title and the other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as written in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers (known from the document summaries) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed papers from the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
